mentions.name: Ephyra
mentions.description: Ephyra is an application that helps founders with no technical knowledge find vulnerabilities in their products and fix them. It is currently an MVP, with planned future features including categories beyond code, monitoring, and problem solving.
mentions.problem: Many founders have no technical knowledge and either ship products with no concern for development practices and safety, or sell things without actually having them.
mentions.source_excerpt: I created Ephyra (https://ephyra.tech): an application to help founders with no technical knowledge to find vulnerabilities and help them to fix it. It is still an MVP, but I have many ideas for the future, such as more categories that go beyond the code, monitoring, problem solving, etc.
